To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Maryland Public Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

All available contracting and procurement documents and communications, including requests for proposals (RFPs) and/or requests for quotes (RFQs); all bids and proposals; all executed contracts with amendments, extensions, and supportive materials (active and expired); and any related agreements between Maryland Department of Public Safety and Correctional Services and/or Maryland State Government and private healthcare contracting corporations that were active or published between January 1, 2001 and December 31, 2025. This includes any documents related to contracts from before 2001, but active during the period of interest.       

To assist in your search, below is a partial list of documents that we believe should be included in this request:     
-  Request for Proposals -Project No. Q0012013
- DPSCS Q0012013

If healthcare operations for incarcerated individuals in Maryland State Prisons were contracted to entities other than private healthcare contracting corporations (ex. Universities), we request the same available documents during active or published between January 1, 2001 and December 31, 2025.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Elizabeth Evans-Ralston

title: Data on Suspected Border Crosser and Unidentified Decedents, 2014–Present

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Texas Public Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

I request an electronic export (CSV or Excel) from the Nueces County Medical Examiner’s case-management system covering all decedents reported to or examined by the office between January 1, 2014 and the date this request is processed who meet any of the following criteria: (a) suspected or confirmed undocumented border crossers (UBCs); (b) nationality recorded as other than U.S.; or (c) unidentified at the time of examination or at present. For each case I request the fields listed below, along with any data dictionary or codebook for these fields. I am not requesting autopsy reports, photographs, or full case files, unless those are the only records available of these decedents.
- Medical examiner case number
- External report/case number/s
- Name of decedent (where releasable)
- Date of death
- Date of discovery
- Latitude of recovery
- Longitude of recovery
- Location of recovery (descriptive)
- Manner of death
- Cause of death
- Age (or estimated age range)
- Sex
- Nationality
- Identification status
- Reporting and/or recovering agency
- Condition of remains
- Disposition of remains
- Whether an autopsy was performed
- Date and method of identification

Please note that the requested records are for use in noncommercial academic research. I am happy to accept records on a rolling basis and to discuss narrowing the request if it is burdensome. If any fields are withheld or redacted, please identify them and cite the legal basis.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Zoe Sigman

title: FOIA REQUEST: Unmasking the DDOT "Ghost Inspector" & Branch Chief Duff McCully Leave Records

communications.subject: DC Freedom of Information Act Request: FOIA REQUEST: Unmasking the DDOT "Ghost Inspector" & Branch Chief Duff McCully Leave Records
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the DC Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

TITLE: FOIA REQUEST: Cityworks API Fraud (System ID 2600205) & Branch Chief Duff McCully Time-and-Attendance Records

To the DDOT FOIA Officer (Ryann Sargent):

Pursuant to the D.C. Freedom of Information Act, I request the immediate production of internal DDOT system records necessary to identify the District employee who falsified a public safety inspection, as well as the administrative whereabouts of Urban Forestry Branch Chief Duff McCully during the lifecycle of this hazard.

PART 1: The Cityworks API Fraud
On October 22, 2026, the Office of Unified Communications (OUC) released backend Salesforce logs for 311 Service Request #26-00495403 regarding an "Imminent Danger" tree hazard at 1490 Morris Rd SE. 

The OUC logs confirm this ticket was closed in exactly 30 minutes with zero geolocated metadata or photographs via an anonymous API bridge ("citizen Site Guest User"). The logs prove the ticket was routed to DDOT's internal management software, specifically identifying the External System Name as "CityWork-Open311Interface," External Service Request as "ESR-0002726802," and internal System Id as "2600205."

I demand the native DDOT Cityworks backend audit log for System Id 2600205 (dated August 18, 2026, to August 26, 2026). Specifically:
1. The exact Active Directory login ID, employee name, and badge number of the DDOT employee who operated within Cityworks to mark this ticket as "Closed" on August 19, 2026.
2. The specific DDOT employee or supervisor who authorized the use of the Cityworks API to administratively desk-reject an active landslide hazard.

PART 2: Branch Chief Duff McCully Attendance & Operations
To verify administrative availability and supervisory oversight regarding this specific hazard, I demand:
3. All official time-and-attendance records, out-of-office designations, and documented medical leave filings for Urban Forestry Branch Chief Duff McCully from April 1, 2026, to August 26, 2026.

Fee Waiver Request: Pursuant to D.C. Official Code § 2-532(b), I request a full fee waiver. Disclosure is in the immediate public interest to expose municipal infrastructure failures, the falsification of environmental safety records on Ward 8 Safe Schools Routes, and potential time-and-attendance fraud.

Fred Gamble Jr.
Ward 8 Community Advocate

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 15 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

FRED GAMBLE JR
